backscatter-series.title: Backscatter series
backscatter-series.description: Give the radar backscatter of many dates, at a point or as the mean of the area, in decibels.

inputs.title: Input layers
inputs.description: The id of each input layer, in any order. A layer is given once.

point.title: Point
point.description: The point of the series, in degrees of longitude and latitude (WGS 84). Without it the series is that of the whole area of the layers.

series.title: Series
series.description: The description of the series that the job produced, with the value of every date.

coherence-series.title: Coherence series
coherence-series.description: Give the interferometric coherence of many pairs of dates, at a point or as the mean of the area.
